title: 'Antisemitic dictator': Netanyahu slams Erdogan after Turkey seeks Interpol action
summary_full: Israel's Prime Minister Netanyahu fiercely criticized Turkey's President Erdogan after Ankara sought an Interpol notice.  Erdogan's government requested the notice concerning an interception of a Gaza aid flotilla.  Netanyahu's office labeled Erdogan an antisemitic dictator with numerous accusations.  This exchange escalates existing tensions between the two nations over Syria.  Both countries are engaged in a diplomatic and legal dispute over these matters.
